column2: One frame at a time per direction; a frame that started is not interrupted
Stop-and-wait: the next frame of the message enters ready only when the previous one got its ACK
Timeout = 2 frame times (the other board may be mid-frame before it answers)
NACK or timeout: the whole frame is repeated; the receiver keeps the good cells and the repeat fills the holes
SEQ: if an ACK is lost and a repeated frame arrives the receiver drops it and sends the ACK again
Aging: a frame that waits more than 3 turns in ready moves up one level; nothing waits forever
PING only if nothing was sent for 3 frame times; any received frame counts as a sign of life
At most 8 retries; then the frame goes to FAILED and the message is marked as not delivered
